Additional Content: Golden Order - Expansion

The Golden Order expansion brings new decorative elements to personalize your gameplay experience, including exclusive characters and emblems.

Package Details

Decorative Characters:

3 additional playable characters, available for visual customization, without direct impact on gameplay.

Decorative Badges:

3 exclusive emblems, which can be used to decorate or customize profiles and items in the game.
